title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate the diffusion and persistence of mask-wearing behavior in a population under social influence, policies, and messaging.

interactions.name: social_influence_contagion
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers (neighbors in the social network and co-located agents) and update their intention to wear masks via social influence and descriptive norms.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; non-compliant individuals may be denied entry or fined with some probability based on enforcement level.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: PolicyMaker broadcasts messaging about mask effectiveness and current case rates, shifting agents' risk perception and trust-mediated compliance.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household members influence each other's mask-wearing through discussions and shared norms; households may share mask stock subject to availability.

interactions.name: location_based_observation
interactions.description: Agents observe compliance at locations and update perceptions of local norms, affecting future compliance decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily proportion of agents wearing a mask.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of agents wearing masks at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days to reach the target adoption threshold.

metrics.name: compliance_by_location
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate observed within each location type.

metrics.name: sustained_compliance_duration
metrics.description: Average length of consecutive days of mask-wearing among adopters.

metrics.name: switching_rate
metrics.description: Daily fraction of agents changing state between wearing and not wearing (behavioral volatility).

metrics.name: inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic or risk groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to policy (e.g., pre/post difference or with/without counterfactual).

metrics.name: peer_exposure_index
metrics.description: Average share of masked peers in each agent’s neighborhood, indicating strength of social signal.
